title: A Family Beach Week on the Makarska Riviera

bestPeriod.note: Late June and September are calmer and cheaper.
bestPeriod.avoid: October to April, when most beach bars and boats stop

accommodation.note: An apartment for four, shared, six nights

food.note: Self-catering breakfasts and lunches, konoba dinners

transport.note: Bus from Split, boat to Bol, local buses

activities.note: Biokovo Skywalk, boat day, Cetina canyon

profile.difficultyNote: 1/5, beaches and short walks; every day trip suits children from 5

gatewayAirport: SPU Split, 1 h 45 min to Makarska by bus
summary: One apartment, no packing up, and a different beach every day. Makarska sits between the pine-backed pebble coves of the riviera and the wall of Biokovo behind it, with a boat to Zlatni Rat on Brač and the Cetina canyon at Omiš within an hour. Shallow pebble shelves, lifeguards on the town beach and ice cream on every promenade.
hook: Seven days, one apartment, five beaches and a glass skywalk 1,228 m above the sea.

itinerary.title: Arrive and settle in
itinerary.morning: Bus from Split airport or the bus station to Makarska, about 1 h 45 min, from €10.
itinerary.afternoon: Unpack, find the supermarket and walk the Makarska promenade to the town beach.
itinerary.evening: Pizza on the harbour and a first swim off the Sveti Petar peninsula.

itinerary.title: The town beach and the Sveti Petar woods
itinerary.morning: Morning on the main beach, shallow pebbles and lifeguards in summer.
itinerary.afternoon: Shaded walk round the Sveti Petar peninsula to the lighthouse, 2 km on a flat path.
itinerary.evening: Fish platter at a konoba in the old town.

itinerary.title: Punta Rata at Brela
itinerary.morning: Bus to Brela in 20 minutes for Punta Rata, often named the most beautiful beach in Europe.
itinerary.afternoon: Picnic under the pines, then snorkel round the rock with its single pine.
itinerary.evening: Back by bus or the coastal path, 8 km, for older children.

itinerary.title: Boat day to Zlatni Rat on Brač
itinerary.morning: Summer excursion boats leave Makarska harbour for Bol on Brač, about 1 h, around €35 an adult and half for children.
itinerary.afternoon: Zlatni Rat, the horn-shaped spit that moves with the wind, and warm shallow water on both sides.
itinerary.evening: Boat back at about 17:00; early night.

itinerary.title: Biokovo Skywalk
itinerary.morning: Shuttle up the Biokovo nature park road to the glass Skywalk at 1,228 m, booked the day before. Park ticket about €20 to €30 an adult in season.
itinerary.afternoon: Back down for a lazy afternoon on Nugal beach, or the town beach with small children.
itinerary.evening: Ice cream and the evening promenade.

itinerary.title: The Cetina canyon at Omiš
itinerary.morning: Bus to Omiš in 40 minutes; family rafting on the Cetina runs from age 5 with a guide, about €30.
itinerary.afternoon: Lunch in Omiš old town under the pirate fortress.

itinerary.title: Back to Split
itinerary.morning: A last morning swim, then the bus to Split, 1 h 45 min.
itinerary.afternoon: Two hours in Diocletian's Palace before the airport bus if flights allow.

accommodationStrategy.name: Apartment in Makarska
accommodationStrategy.description: A two-bedroom apartment with a kitchen and a balcony sleeps four; the price is shared by the party.
accommodationStrategy.booking: two to three months ahead for July and August
accommodationStrategy.priceNote: €90 to €150 a night for the apartment

logistics.connectivity: EU roaming works; 4G everywhere on the coast.
logistics.emergency: 112; lifeguards on Makarska town beach from June to September.
logistics.weather: The bora can close boats on two or three days a summer; keep the boat day flexible.
logistics.bookingWindows: Skywalk shuttles and rafting book out in August; book a day or two ahead.
logistics.money: Euro; cards work almost everywhere, boats prefer cash.
logistics.transportRules: Children under 6 travel free on most local buses; excursion boats charge half for 3 to 12.
logistics.health: Pebble beaches: water shoes save tears.
logistics.gettingThere: Fly to Split; the airport bus links to the coastal buses south.

proTips: Pick an apartment on the Sveti Petar side: shade in the afternoon and a shorter walk to the quiet coves.
Go to Punta Rata before 10:00 for space under the pines.

typeSpecific.windConditions: Bora can stop boats for a day
typeSpecific.bookingTimeline: Apartment two to three months ahead for July and August

packingNotes: A beach umbrella or rent one
whatCouldGoWrong: The bora can cancel the Bol boat; swap it with the Cetina day.
August beaches fill by 11:00; go early or after 16:00.

highlights.title: Punta Rata
highlights.line: Turquoise water and one pine on a rock, 20 minutes by bus.

highlights.title: Zlatni Rat by boat
highlights.line: The golden horn of Brač, warm shallows on both sides.

highlights.title: Biokovo Skywalk
highlights.line: A glass platform 1,228 m above the riviera.

highlights.title: Makarska promenade
highlights.line: Ice cream, palm trees and a lifeguarded town beach.
